# Rapier JXL

MIT JPEG XL encoder. No runtime dependencies. Source package and generated self-contained bundles.

- `rapier-jxl` / `rapier-jxl/capture`: async encode(source, options) -> Uint8Array. Exact RGBA8 default; optional maxError integer0..8 bounds visible RGB, preserves alpha/hidden RGB.
- `rapier-jxl/photo`: async encode(source,{quality:90,effort:9}) or internal perceptual target; also low-level encodePhoto and encodeToScore APIs.
- `rapier-jxl/full`: complete worker/Node factory, animation, JPEG reconstruction, HDR/ICC, format and metadata tools; every specialist feature retained.
- `rapier-jxl/image`: createEncoder({worker:URL|factory,maxQueue:2}) -> {encode,close}. Persistent private worker, borrowed input, cancellation and bounded queue.
- `rapier-jxl/core`: previous general low-level encode(rgba,width,height,{quality}) and incremental/async forms.

Serve dist/capture-worker.js, photo-worker.js or full-worker.js from a host-resolved URL. The worker does not download code. Do not use a bare npm specifier in new URL() as if it were a browser package resolver. Already in a worker queue: import direct encode; do not nest workers.

The public integration contract is docs/INTEGRATION.md, type declarations src/image.d.mts and src/capture.d.mts. npm run build fails on runtime/type contract regressions. Full specialist API is docs/reference/API.md. Measured module sizes, quality/speed/memory and caveats: docs/CAPTURE-AUDIT.md; reproducible harness/raw data: bench/capture/. No universal quality or performance claim follows from one corpus. Native JPEG XL decoding is not included.

Reference SnapDOM defineExports plugin and offline local demo: examples/snapdom/. Draft comments there are for Jack to post, not automatic submissions.
